title: 非能動餘熱移除系統
subcategoryTitle: 核安全、除役與後端土木工程
subcategoryTitleEn: Nuclear safety, decommissioning and back-end civil works
summary: 福島事故後，各國新一代反應爐設計都加入了不需交流電源的餘熱移除系統：有的把熱傳到大水箱使其沸騰，有的直接以空氣冷卻。課程以公開的設計原理比較幾種做法，定量分析衰變熱、自然循環壓頭、水箱到達沸騰的時間、空冷器的煙囪抽力、容量與需求的餘裕，以及凝結水回收對持續時間的影響。
summaryEn: Since Fukushima new reactor designs everywhere include residual-heat removal that needs no AC power: some pass heat to a large tank that boils, others cool directly with air. Comparing several approaches through public design principles, the course quantifies decay heat, natural-circulation head, time for a tank to reach boiling, stack draft of air coolers, margin of capacity over demand, and how condensate return extends duration.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.

nodes: 廢棄物或用過燃料來源

v30Focus: 不靠電力的餘熱移除：水箱的升溫時間、煙囪抽力、低壓差逆止閥與功能可靠度
v30FocusEn: Residual-heat removal without electricity: tank heat-up time, stack draft, low-differential check valves and functional reliability

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：非能動餘熱移除系統
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Passive Residual Heat Removal Systems
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「衰變熱與停機後冷卻」與「水箱到達沸騰的時間」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Decay heat and post-shutdown cooling" and "Time for the tank to reach boiling": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「衰變熱與停機後冷卻」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Decay heat and post-shutdown cooling" is correct?
options: 反應爐停機後，分裂鏈鎖反應立即停止，但分裂產物的放射性衰變仍持續放熱。
反應爐一停機就不再發熱，可以馬上停止冷卻。
水箱裡的水一開始就會沸騰。
optionsEn: After shutdown the fission chain reaction stops at once, but radioactive decay of fission products keeps releasing heat.
A reactor stops producing heat as soon as it is shut down, so cooling can stop immediately.
Water in the tank boils from the start.
quiz.explanation: 反應爐停機後，分裂鏈鎖反應立即停止，但分裂產物的放射性衰變仍持續放熱。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: After shutdown the fission chain reaction stops at once, but radioactive decay of fission products keeps releasing heat. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 衰變熱與停機後冷卻：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Decay heat and post-shutdown cooling: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「衰變熱與停機後冷卻」如何決定「非能動餘熱移除系統」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Decay heat and post-shutdown cooling” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Passive Residual Heat Removal Systems”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 反應爐停機後，分裂鏈鎖反應立即停止，但分裂產物的放射性衰變仍持續放熱。衰變熱在停機瞬間約為滿載熱功率的 6% 至 7%，一小時後降到約 1.5% 以下，一天後約 0.5%，之後緩慢遞減。這就是為什麼停機後仍必須長時間維持冷卻與最終熱沉，也是所有餘熱移除與非能動安全系統的設計基礎。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After shutdown the fission chain reaction stops at once, but radioactive decay of fission products keeps releasing heat. Decay heat is about 6–7% of full thermal power at the instant of shutdown, below about 1.5% after an hour and about 0.5% after a day, then declines slowly. This is why cooling and an ultimate heat sink must be maintained long after shutdown, and it is the design basis of all residual-heat-removal and passive safety systems. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：停機後 1 小時的衰變熱約為額定熱功率的 1.5%，1 天後約 0.5%
steps.observationEn: Project file: Decay heat is about 1.5% of rated thermal power 1 hour after shutdown and about 0.5% after 1 day
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「反應爐一停機就不再發熱，可以馬上停止冷卻。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A reactor stops producing heat as soon as it is shut down, so cooling can stop immediately." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「衰變熱與停機後冷卻」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Decay heat and post-shutdown cooling”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 衰變熱與停機後冷卻
knowledge.text: 反應爐停機後，分裂鏈鎖反應立即停止，但分裂產物的放射性衰變仍持續放熱。衰變熱在停機瞬間約為滿載熱功率的 6% 至 7%，一小時後降到約 1.5% 以下，一天後約 0.5%，之後緩慢遞減。這就是為什麼停機後仍必須長時間維持冷卻與最終熱沉，也是所有餘熱移除與非能動安全系統的設計基礎。
knowledge.textEn: After shutdown the fission chain reaction stops at once, but radioactive decay of fission products keeps releasing heat. Decay heat is about 6–7% of full thermal power at the instant of shutdown, below about 1.5% after an hour and about 0.5% after a day, then declines slowly. This is why cooling and an ultimate heat sink must be maintained long after shutdown, and it is the design basis of all residual-heat-removal and passive safety systems.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：反應爐一停機就不再發熱，可以馬上停止冷卻。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A reactor stops producing heat as soon as it is shut down, so cooling can stop immediately. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 停機後 1 小時的衰變熱約為額定熱功率的 1.5%，1 天後約 0.5%
knowledge.textEn: Decay heat is about 1.5% of rated thermal power 1 hour after shutdown and about 0.5% after 1 day

quiz.question: 依「衰變熱與停機後冷卻」的模型 P_d ≈ 0.066·P_th·[t^−0.2 − (t+T)^−0.2]，滿載運轉一年後停機 1 小時的衰變熱（Way–Wigner 近似）最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model P_d ≈ 0.066·P_th·[t^−0.2 − (t+T)^−0.2] for "Decay heat and post-shutdown cooling", which value is closest to the decay heat one hour after shutdown following a year at full power (Way–Wigner approximation)?
options: 365 MW
optionsEn: 365 MW
quiz.explanation: P_d ≈ 0.066·P_th·[t^−0.2 − (t+T)^−0.2]；代入 Pth = 3400 MW、t = 3600 s、T = 31536000 s，得 36.5 MW（滿載運轉一年後停機 1 小時的衰變熱（Way–Wigner 近似））。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: P_d ≈ 0.066·P_th·[t^−0.2 − (t+T)^−0.2]; with Pth = 3400 MW, t = 3600 s, T = 31536000 s the result is 36.5 MW (decay heat one hour after shutdown following a year at full power (Way–Wigner approximation)). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 衰變熱與停機後冷卻：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Decay heat and post-shutdown cooling: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「衰變熱與停機後冷卻」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Decay heat and post-shutdown cooling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：P_d ≈ 0.066·P_th·[t^−0.2 − (t+T)^−0.2]；代入 Pth = 3400 MW、t = 3600 s、T = 31536000 s，得 36.5 MW（滿載運轉一年後停機 1 小時的衰變熱（Way–Wigner 近似））。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 t 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: P_d ≈ 0.066·P_th·[t^−0.2 − (t+T)^−0.2]; with Pth = 3400 MW, t = 3600 s, T = 31536000 s the result is 36.5 MW (decay heat one hour after shutdown following a year at full power (Way–Wigner approximation)). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise t by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：t 增加 10% 時，結果變為 35.7 MW（-2.3%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising t by 10% changes the result to 35.7 MW (-2.3%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 36.5 MW（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 t 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 36.5 MW (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in t with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: P_d ≈ 0.066·P_th·[t^−0.2 − (t+T)^−0.2]；代入 Pth = 3400 MW、t = 3600 s、T = 31536000 s，得 36.5 MW（滿載運轉一年後停機 1 小時的衰變熱（Way–Wigner 近似））。
knowledge.textEn: P_d ≈ 0.066·P_th·[t^−0.2 − (t+T)^−0.2]; with Pth = 3400 MW, t = 3600 s, T = 31536000 s the result is 36.5 MW (decay heat one hour after shutdown following a year at full power (Way–Wigner approximation)).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: t 增加 10% 時，結果變為 35.7 MW（-2.3%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising t by 10% changes the result to 35.7 MW (-2.3%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「衰變熱與停機後冷卻」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Decay heat and post-shutdown cooling"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
通道越多系統就越可靠，與它們是否獨立無關。
以停機冷卻期間餘熱移除熱交換器的流量與進出口溫差計算實際移熱量，與標準衰變熱曲線（如 ANS 5.1）比較，確認冷卻能力的餘裕。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
More channels always mean a more reliable system, whether or not they are independent.

Compute actual heat removal from flow and temperature difference across the residual-heat-removal exchangers during shutdown cooling, compare with a standard decay-heat curve such as ANS 5.1, and confirm cooling margin.
quiz.explanation: 以停機冷卻期間餘熱移除熱交換器的流量與進出口溫差計算實際移熱量，與標準衰變熱曲線（如 ANS 5.1）比較，確認冷卻能力的餘裕。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compute actual heat removal from flow and temperature difference across the residual-heat-removal exchangers during shutdown cooling, compare with a standard decay-heat curve such as ANS 5.1, and confirm cooling margin. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 衰變熱與停機後冷卻：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Decay heat and post-shutdown cooling: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「衰變熱與停機後冷卻」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Decay heat and post-shutdown cooling” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以停機冷卻期間餘熱移除熱交換器的流量與進出口溫差計算實際移熱量，與標準衰變熱曲線（如 ANS 5.1）比較，確認冷卻能力的餘裕。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute actual heat removal from flow and temperature difference across the residual-heat-removal exchangers during shutdown cooling, compare with a standard decay-heat curve such as ANS 5.1, and confirm cooling margin. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：任何會影響餘熱移除路徑的檢修，都要先確認此刻的衰變熱與可用冷卻串數，並保留一條獨立的備用路徑。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Before any maintenance affecting residual-heat-removal paths, confirm current decay heat and available cooling trains, and keep one independent path in reserve.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：2011 年福島第一核電廠在地震後已成功停機，但海嘯使交流與直流電源喪失，衰變熱無法移除而導致爐心受損，說明「停機」不等於「安全」。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: At Fukushima Daiichi in 2011 the reactors shut down successfully after the earthquake, but the tsunami took away AC and DC power, decay heat could not be removed and the cores were damaged, showing that shutdown is not the same as safe. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以停機冷卻期間餘熱移除熱交換器的流量與進出口溫差計算實際移熱量，與標準衰變熱曲線（如 ANS 5.1）比較，確認冷卻能力的餘裕。
knowledge.textEn: Compute actual heat removal from flow and temperature difference across the residual-heat-removal exchangers during shutdown cooling, compare with a standard decay-heat curve such as ANS 5.1, and confirm cooling margin.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 任何會影響餘熱移除路徑的檢修，都要先確認此刻的衰變熱與可用冷卻串數，並保留一條獨立的備用路徑。
knowledge.textEn: Before any maintenance affecting residual-heat-removal paths, confirm current decay heat and available cooling trains, and keep one independent path in reserve.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IAEA SSR-5 放射性廢棄物處置。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IAEA SSR-5 Disposal of Radioactive Waste. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「衰變熱與停機後冷卻」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Decay heat and post-shutdown cooling" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 2011 年福島第一核電廠在地震後已成功停機，但海嘯使交流與直流電源喪失，衰變熱無法移除而導致爐心受損，說明「停機」不等於「安全」。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
水箱裡的水一開始就會沸騰。
optionsEn: At Fukushima Daiichi in 2011 the reactors shut down successfully after the earthquake, but the tsunami took away AC and DC power, decay heat could not be removed and the cores were damaged, showing that shutdown is not the same as safe.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
Water in the tank boils from the start.
quiz.explanation: 2011 年福島第一核電廠在地震後已成功停機，但海嘯使交流與直流電源喪失，衰變熱無法移除而導致爐心受損，說明「停機」不等於「安全」。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: At Fukushima Daiichi in 2011 the reactors shut down successfully after the earthquake, but the tsunami took away AC and DC power, decay heat could not be removed and the cores were damaged, showing that shutdown is not the same as safe. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 衰變熱與停機後冷卻：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Decay heat and post-shutdown cooling: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「衰變熱與停機後冷卻」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Decay heat and post-shutdown cooling” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 2011 年福島第一核電廠在地震後已成功停機，但海嘯使交流與直流電源喪失，衰變熱無法移除而導致爐心受損，說明「停機」不等於「安全」。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「非能動餘熱移除系統」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: At Fukushima Daiichi in 2011 the reactors shut down successfully after the earthquake, but the tsunami took away AC and DC power, decay heat could not be removed and the cores were damaged, showing that shutdown is not the same as safe. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Passive Residual Heat Removal Systems”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這就是為什麼停機後仍必須長時間維持冷卻與最終熱沉，也是所有餘熱移除與非能動安全系統的設計基礎。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This is why cooling and an ultimate heat sink must be maintained long after shutdown, and it is the design basis of all residual-heat-removal and passive safety systems.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「反應爐一停機就不再發熱，可以馬上停止冷卻。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A reactor stops producing heat as soon as it is shut down, so cooling can stop immediately." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

quiz.question: 關於「水箱到達沸騰的時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Time for the tank to reach boiling" is correct?
options: 水箱裡的水一開始就會沸騰。
非能動系統沒有會壞的零件，所以不需要試驗與維護。
把熱交換器浸在一個大水箱裡，是最簡單的非能動餘熱移除方式：一次側的熱水靠自然循環流過管內，把熱傳給箱裡的冷水。
optionsEn: Water in the tank boils from the start.
Passive systems have no parts that can fail, so they need no testing or maintenance.
Immersing a heat exchanger in a large tank is the simplest passive residual-heat removal: hot primary water circulates naturally through the tubes and gives heat to cold water in the tank.
quiz.explanation: 把熱交換器浸在一個大水箱裡，是最簡單的非能動餘熱移除方式：一次側的熱水靠自然循環流過管內，把熱傳給箱裡的冷水。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Immersing a heat exchanger in a large tank is the simplest passive residual-heat removal: hot primary water circulates naturally through the tubes and gives heat to cold water in the tank. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水箱到達沸騰的時間：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Time for the tank to reach boiling: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「水箱到達沸騰的時間」如何決定「非能動餘熱移除系統」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Time for the tank to reach boiling” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Passive Residual Heat Removal Systems”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 把熱交換器浸在一個大水箱裡，是最簡單的非能動餘熱移除方式：一次側的熱水靠自然循環流過管內，把熱傳給箱裡的冷水。開始時水箱只是升溫，吸收的是顯熱；等到整箱水達到沸點，才開始沸騰蒸發，改由潛熱吸收。水箱越大，沸騰開始得越晚，那時的衰變熱也已經下降不少。蒸汽升到鋼製圍阻體的內壁凝結，熱再由圍阻體外側的空氣與水膜帶走。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Immersing a heat exchanger in a large tank is the simplest passive residual-heat removal: hot primary water circulates naturally through the tubes and gives heat to cold water in the tank. At first the tank simply warms, absorbing sensible heat; only when all the water reaches boiling point does it begin to evaporate and absorb latent heat. The larger the tank the later boiling starts, by when decay heat has fallen a good deal. Steam rises to condense on the inner wall of the steel containment, and air and a water film outside carry the heat away. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：AP1000 的非能動餘熱移除熱交換器浸在容量約 2,100 m³ 的圍阻體內換料水箱中
steps.observationEn: Project file: The passive residual heat removal heat exchanger of the AP1000 sits in an in-containment refuelling water storage tank of about 2,100 m³
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水箱裡的水一開始就會沸騰。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Water in the tank boils from the start." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「水箱到達沸騰的時間」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Time for the tank to reach boiling”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 依「水箱到達沸騰的時間」的模型 t = m·c_p·ΔT / P，2,100 m³ 的水由 30 °C 升到 100 °C、平均吸熱功率 60 MW 時所需的時間（平均功率為教學假設）最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model t = m·c_p·ΔT / P for "Time for the tank to reach boiling", which value is closest to the time for 2,100 m³ of water to go from 30 °C to 100 °C at a mean 60 MW absorbed (teaching mean power)?
quiz.explanation: t = m·c_p·ΔT / P；代入 V = 2100 m³、dT = 70 K、P = 60 MW，得 2.9 h（2,100 m³ 的水由 30 °C 升到 100 °C、平均吸熱功率 60 MW 時所需的時間（平均功率為教學假設））。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: t = m·c_p·ΔT / P; with V = 2100 m³, dT = 70 K, P = 60 MW the result is 2.9 h (time for 2,100 m³ of water to go from 30 °C to 100 °C at a mean 60 MW absorbed (teaching mean power)). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 水箱到達沸騰的時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Time for the tank to reach boiling: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水箱到達沸騰的時間」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Time for the tank to reach boiling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：t = m·c_p·ΔT / P；代入 V = 2100 m³、dT = 70 K、P = 60 MW，得 2.9 h（2,100 m³ 的水由 30 °C 升到 100 °C、平均吸熱功率 60 MW 時所需的時間（平均功率為教學假設））。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 P 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: t = m·c_p·ΔT / P; with V = 2100 m³, dT = 70 K, P = 60 MW the result is 2.9 h (time for 2,100 m³ of water to go from 30 °C to 100 °C at a mean 60 MW absorbed (teaching mean power)). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise P by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：P 增加 10% 時，結果變為 2.6 h（-9.1%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising P by 10% changes the result to 2.6 h (-9.1%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 2.9 h（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 P 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 2.9 h (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in P with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: t = m·c_p·ΔT / P；代入 V = 2100 m³、dT = 70 K、P = 60 MW，得 2.9 h（2,100 m³ 的水由 30 °C 升到 100 °C、平均吸熱功率 60 MW 時所需的時間（平均功率為教學假設））。
knowledge.textEn: t = m·c_p·ΔT / P; with V = 2100 m³, dT = 70 K, P = 60 MW the result is 2.9 h (time for 2,100 m³ of water to go from 30 °C to 100 °C at a mean 60 MW absorbed (teaching mean power)).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: P 增加 10% 時，結果變為 2.6 h（-9.1%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising P by 10% changes the result to 2.6 h (-9.1%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水箱到達沸騰的時間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Time for the tank to reach boiling"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以整體效應試驗設施量測水箱內的溫度分層與熱交換器的移熱能力隨水溫的變化，並與分析程式比較。
非能動系統沒有會壞的零件，所以可靠度是百分之百。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
Integral test facilities measure temperature stratification in the tank and how heat-exchanger capacity varies with water temperature, compared with analysis codes.
A passive system has no parts to fail, so its reliability is a hundred percent.
quiz.explanation: 以整體效應試驗設施量測水箱內的溫度分層與熱交換器的移熱能力隨水溫的變化，並與分析程式比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Integral test facilities measure temperature stratification in the tank and how heat-exchanger capacity varies with water temperature, compared with analysis codes. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 水箱到達沸騰的時間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Time for the tank to reach boiling: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水箱到達沸騰的時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Time for the tank to reach boiling” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以整體效應試驗設施量測水箱內的溫度分層與熱交換器的移熱能力隨水溫的變化，並與分析程式比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Integral test facilities measure temperature stratification in the tank and how heat-exchanger capacity varies with water temperature, compared with analysis codes. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：水箱的設計容量要以保守的分層假設驗算，熱交換器的位置與形狀以試驗確認能帶動池水混合。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Check tank design capacity with conservative stratification assumptions, and confirm by test that position and shape of the heat exchanger stir the pool.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：水箱內若形成穩定的熱分層，上層水先達到沸點而下層仍冷，有效的吸熱容量小於全箱均溫的計算值。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If stable thermal stratification forms in the tank, the upper layer boils while the lower stays cold, and effective heat capacity is less than a fully mixed calculation. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
